description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects double-colon traversal components on Atlassian resource-download routes.
affected_versions: Atlassian Bamboo Data Center: All other versions; Atlassian Bitbucket Data Center: All other versions; Atlassian Confluence Data Center: All other versions; Atlassian Crowd Data Center: All other versions; Atlassian Crucible Data Center: All other versions; Atlassian Fisheye Data Center: All other versions; Atlassian Jira Service Management Data Center: All other versions; Atlassian Jira Software Data Center: All other versions; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects double-colon traversal components on Atlassian resource-download routes.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Literal ..:: resource names are denied; ordinary resource downloads remain eligible.
